messages:
alex: late refactor to kernel packing just landed into the night bucket and was promoted to the canary slice. heads up, I'm going to watch telemetry closely.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by alex at 2026-03-20 23:40 UTC — job id 2026-03-20-2340-kg. Canary slice: engine-v3.2.1-refactor.
maria: what's the first signal? any errors or just perf?
alex: so far just perf jitter on canary. p99 latency +8% on the canary slice over the last 10m, throughput stable, no 5xx.
samir: can you pull kv cache hitrate? packing changes could affect prefix caching for long seqs.
kevin: pulling telemetry now — kv_hit_rate down ~2.1% for seq_len>1024, CPU jitter on matmul worker threads. stacks look like new packing path.
jess: we need a short release note blurb and a rollback criteria. Ops will want explicit numbers.
alex: propose: hold global cutover until morning bake window, keep canary pinned. rollback if p99 > +10% vs baseline OR error rate rises >0.1% sustained for 15m. also set pin TTL to 12h for canary.
maria: +1 to holding. also create a one-paragraph release note and ops playbook (how to toggle flag, rollback steps).
samir: I'll run a targeted repro on staging with long sequences and do an isolated matmul perf profile.
infra-bot: Staging smoke-run: all health checks PASS — runtime, kv-store, and canary-sim passed (2026-03-20T23:45Z).
kevin: quick mitigation idea: the runtime has a runtime flag `pack_enable`. if we flip it false on the canary slice, we can validate whether packing path causes the hitrate drop. patch ready.
alex: can we patch only the canary slice without touching staging/other slices? want to minimize blast radius.
deploy-bot: Yes — can apply per-slice flag. Example command:
```
/deploybot patch --slice=canary --env=prod --flag pack_enable=false
```
alex: applying the patch to canary now. will monitor for 10m.
deploy-bot: Patch applied to canary slice by alex.
kevin: quick check: p99 trending back toward baseline, kv_hit_rate returning to normal within 3 minutes of flip. CPU smoothing too.
maria: great — keep the patch on canary and schedule a controlled roll-forward in the AM after a longer bake. jess, please update release notes.
jess: added to release notes draft: "engine: kernel packing refactor (v3.2.1-refactor) — observed temporary kv cache hit regression on long sequences; mitigation: pack_enable flag can be toggled per-slice. Full roll-forward deferred to next bake window." I'll drop the doc link in the ticket.
alex: set pin on canary build engine-v3.2.1-refactor with TTL 12h and added rollback criteria in ticket #INF-4122.
samir: creating follow-up perf ticket to validate quantized matmul path and long-seq cache behavior.
alex: good. if any signal crosses thresholds, we roll back the canary to engine-v3.2.0 and escalate. otherwise we plan a staged roll-forward tomorrow AM during the quiet window. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate release note publication and add an ops checklist: steps to flip `pack_enable`, how to pin/unpin via deploy-bot, and rollback commands.
kevin: saving the canary perf snapshot and attaching to ticket.
alex: closing loop — ping here if anything flips overnight. thanks.
